dct_description_sm: A LiDAR dataset was acquired to provide accurate ground elevations and return intensities for the outer Mackenzie Delta.  The data will be used as a tool to help accurately predict coastal storm surge and spring freshet flooding levels, morphological characterization, and to provide a baseline for future erosion and sedimentation/subsidence studies.
dct_title_s: LiDAR Elevation (DEM) and Intensity image, outer Mackenzie Delta 2008, coastal Arctic Canada
